}}'''Leya''' was a ''[[Tuatha'an]]'' woman who reported to [[Moiraine Damodred]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Leya|Leya}}

==Apperance==
Gray-haired with a few lines on her face.

==Activities==
Leya rode into the Dragon's camp and was escorted inside by [[Perrin Aybara]] and some Shienarans soldiers.{{ref/book|3|1}} While she reported to Moiraine about conditions on [[Almoth Plain]], [[Min Farshaw]] had a viewing about Leya's death.{{ref/book|3|2}} Leya was injured during [[Rand al'Thor]]'s loss of control over the [[One Power]] and later died during the [[Trolloc]] attack.{{ref/book|3|5}}

== Death ==
She was killed by a [[Fade]].{{Ref||Leya}}
